kind: Read-only full recorded edition/relationship domain, not native/gold
SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT obj.tableId AS tableId,obj.tableNumber AS tableNumber,obj.tableCaption AS tableCaption
            FROM Spec hub JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id
            JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
            JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=edition.node_id
            JOIN Section anchor ON anchor.node_id=bs.src_id
            JOIN rel_CONTAINS_TABLE edge ON edge.src_id=anchor.node_id
            JOIN TSTable obj ON obj.node_id=edge.dst_id
            WHERE hub.specNumber=? AND hub.specRelease IS NULL AND anchor.sectionNumber=?
            ORDER BY obj.tableId
anchor_census_SQL:
SELECT edition.node_id AS editionNode,edition.specRelease,edition.specVersion,
            anchor.node_id AS anchorNode,anchor.sectionId AS anchorId,anchor.sectionTitle AS anchorTitle
            FROM Spec hub JOIN rel_IN_RELEASE_OF ir ON ir.dst_id=hub.node_id
            JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=ir.src_id
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.* ,b.dst_id AS ownerSpec FROM Section s JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC b ON b.src_id=s.node_id WHERE s.sectionNumber=?) anchor
            ON anchor.ownerSpec=edition.node_id
            WHERE hub.specNumber=? AND hub.specRelease IS NULL
            ORDER BY edition.specRelease,anchor.node_id

original_KO_record.cypher: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.133'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(sec:Section {sectionNumber:'9.2.5.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH sec,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY t.tableNumber LIMIT 25
